fixed_anchor: Three complete whole checkpoints. All body parameters and persistent masks remain frozen.

conditions.binding: The replica motor pulse encodes the primary population's self-chosen trial side.
conditions.misbound: Each row receives the following independent row's self-chosen trial side, cyclically. Each batch has exactly the same number of sent left and right pulses as its own requests.

trainable: Two motor-axon input columns, feedback from the two replica motor neurons into primary neurons, and primary-only query, forecast and action readouts.
forecast_criterion: Squared error to the actual signed delayed outcome only when the primary's queried and actually executed sides coincide. Stabilized inverse action propensity weighting.
policy_gradient: Both query and action likelihoods are weighted by the actual delayed outcome minus a baseline from previous batches.
